title: Generation counters return to the front page
summary:
Front-page counters returned while the community showcase picked up four more projects and a cleanup.

Generation count badges are back on the image and text feeds, with estimated totals and rates. Feed-switch button labels are also protected from automatic rephrasing.

The Creative Projects directory gained Imagine Draw AI and Aimpress for image generation, Evolve AI for speech, code and images, and What is this? for identifying objects in photos.

Project tables gained refreshed entries and star counts, and the Discord bot listing now points to its contributor’s repository. Long descriptions and author names are shortened so the tables remain readable.
